description: Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU) is a multidisciplinary university on Lucknow-Deva Road in Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral programmes across engineering, management, law, agriculture, pharmacy, computer applications, journalism, sciences and humanities.

agent_notes: Government-directory identity was established on all three supplied NIRF 2025 listing pages; NIRF displays the city as “Bararbanki”, while the official website gives Barabanki.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy’s self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure only against the expected official hosts nirfindia.org and srmu.ac.in.

The official Program Finder returned 136 active records (all status:true) across undergraduate, integrated, postgraduate, Polytechnic(Diploma), Industry Honors and Ph.D. categories; each programme route was reachable with HTTP 200.
